description: Retrieve live 2026/27 Premier League transfer and managerial rumours graded Tier 1-4 with Robozio 0-100 Legs Score and independent desk counts.

club.description: Optional club name or slug to filter transfer rumours (e.g. 'arsenal', 'liverpool').

maxTier.description: Optional maximum source reliability tier (1 = highest reliability, 4 = broad speculation).

minLegs.description: Optional minimum Robozio Legs Score threshold (0-100).

sort.description: Sort order: 'latest' (default recency) or 'legs' (highest Robozio signal strength first).

name: get_transfer_rumours
title: Premier League Transfer Rumours & Robozio Signal Score
